home.lead: Brandon and Katharina believe in making your vacation truly exceptional. Whether you're searching for a secluded mountain-top cabin, a modern downtown condo or a beach villa, our homes are made for every kind of trip in the most sought-after destinations.
home.hostsText: We're Brandon and Katharina, an Atlanta family of four with three rescue dogs. We host every home the way we'd want to be hosted: spotless, thoughtfully stocked and with a real person a message away.

about.title: Modern Comfort. Scenic Retreats. Hosts Who Care.
story: Brandon and Katharina met in Atlanta over 10 years ago. After a destination wedding in Mexico, they had their daughter, Emmy. A few short years later, their family grew with the addition of their son, Leo. As an active family of four, they're always on the go, whether it's swimming lessons, gymnastics, soccer, softball, visiting local playgrounds and the library, or simply out in the neighborhood with their three rescue dogs!
Brandon, originally from Iowa and a former football player, has spent his career in sports. He has worked in college athletics since his arrival in Atlanta over a decade ago.

Being a dual citizen, Katharina was born and raised in Germany before moving to the States. She currently serves as the Director of the German Desk for an international recruiting and consulting firm.

favorites.title: Cherry Log Summit
favorites.text: Check out Leo with his best friend Chewy at Cherry Log Summit. This little man would spend every weekend at the cabin if he could. With a fully fenced-in yard, jacuzzi, outdoor playground and game room, this home is our top choice for families traveling with kids.

favorites.title: Havana Haven
favorites.text: Emmy won't ever pass up an opportunity for a beach vacation. Here she is being silly down in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. Naturally, her favorite home is Havana Haven. With its large heated pool, and located only a mile from the beach, this home has a special place in her heart.

about.join: Join Brandon and Katharina in their pursuit of adventure, family and embracing all that life has to offer.

meet: Brandon and Katharina's journey began over 10 years ago in Atlanta, where they met and quickly became partners in life and business. After a destination wedding in Mexico, their family grew with their daughter, Emmy, and son, Leo, plus three rescue dogs.

Brandon, originally from Iowa, has a deep background in sports and has worked in college athletics since moving to Atlanta. Katharina, a dual citizen born and raised in Germany, is the Director of the German Desk for an international recruiting and consulting firm. Together, they've built a property management business grounded in family values and exceptional service.
